2. Privacy & Excision Architecture

RedactLocal is engineered with strict cryptographic and architectural invariants:

  • It never transmits document bytecodes, filenames, or metadata to any remote server (connect-src 'none').
  • When redaction is executed, targeted character glyph operators (Tj/TJ) are excised from content streams, AcroForm /V values nullified, and underlying raster pixels permanently overwritten rather than masked with opaque black vectors.

3. Practitioner Responsibility

RedactLocal provides deterministic pattern detection (FRCP 5.2, HIPAA Safe Harbor § 164.514, IRS § 7216) and surgical bytecode excision audited by 7 independent verification oracles. However, final legal responsibility for court, regulatory, or client submissions rests with the practitioner. Users should verify redactions before filing.
